name: Many questions match
description: many_questions matches a prompt with four or more explicit questions
query: What's the best way to reduce latency? Should I add a cache? What about connection pooling? Would batching the requests help too?

name: Numbered steps match
description: numbered_steps matches a prompt containing a numbered list item
query:

name: No structure rule matches
